title: Phone Slip: Channel 9 Miami Valley News Assignment Desk, 10:35

fields.message:
Scanner traffic says trench collapse w/ gas leak at Corliss & Ninth, "multiple workers buried." Their helicopter is lifting off now. Asking: How many trapped? Is anyone dead? Need something from Larkspur by 10:50.
ALSO 10:37: Joseph Albrecht (Sewer District) emailed PM. Their Corliss crew hears sirens near Ninth. "What is going on?" Says 16+00 to 18+00 is already on critical path. Needs to know TODAY if it moves.

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. Watch whether the PM calls the owner's representative now, inside the 1-hour window, with facts only, starts the written call log and refuses to discuss schedule. Watch whether the PE holds all comment until the owner has been told. The PE should then give one short holding statement with no victim count, names or cause, and get District PIO Teresa Whitcomb to approve any wording that names the District (LPONRC 4). Note: the call-back number is a made-up 555 number. I didn't use the number in the MSEL row because that number already belongs to Dayton Water Operations.
